Extract one dataset from a multi-member SAS XPORT v8/v9 file

Source: R/read_single_xpt.r
ks_extract_single_xpt.Rd

Reads a single member from the file by splicing the file-level header bytes onto the member's raw bytes, then passing the combined buffer to read_xpt.

Usage

ks_extract_single_xpt(name, file, content)

Arguments

name

Character name of the member to read (must match a name in content, i.e. lower-case).

file

Path to the XPORT file.

content

Named list returned by ks_xpt_content(file).

Value

A tibble (as returned by read_xpt).

Details

A valid XPORT stream requires both the 240-byte file header (three 80-byte LIBV8 records) and the member data. This function prepends the file header so that haven::read_xpt can parse the member in isolation.

See also

ks_xpt_content, ks_batch_load_from_single_xpt

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
content <- ks_xpt_content("study.xpt")
ae      <- ks_extract_single_xpt("ae", "study.xpt", content)
} # }
